description: Asks what CDbl, CCur and CDec return or raise for text operands: decimal forms with a comma, leading or trailing point, exponent forms including overflow and underflow, the largest Double text and one digit above it, a 16-digit integer, a Currency text with a fifth decimal, trailing blank or garbage, NaN and Infinity words, and a hex prefix. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
